execution_contract.wall_clock_accounting: include passive setup, sounder, descriptors, gaps, and padding

physical.per_bin_noise_estimator: 2048-sample Hann windows, 50% overlap, mean complex cross-spectrum; record scalar PSD and full microphone covariance
physical.pixel_input: 48 kHz stereo UNPROCESSED retained; mic 0 primary, mic 1 diagnostic
physical.qam_probe_split: first 16 fit H/noise; last 16 estimate bitwise GMI

policies.rule: Assign 4 bits to every eligible bin. Do not inspect channel or payload outcomes.
Using only the causally prior active known-probe channel magnitude and passive-noise PSD, assign 0 bits below 6 dB SNR, 2 bits from 6 dB inclusive to 13 dB exclusive, and 4 bits at or above 13 dB.

Using only causally prior known sounder/pilot observations and the frozen scalar residual model, assign the highest modulation whose estimated BICM-GMI is at least 1.20 bits/symbol for QPSK or 2.40 bits/symbol for 16-QAM; otherwise turn the bin off.

For independently verified simultaneous microphone inputs, estimate payload-independent complex H and regularized passive-noise covariance, compute the maximum-SINR combiner, then apply P2 thresholds. Fall back exactly to P2 for one usable input or an invalid covariance estimate.

promotion_limits.final_gate: At least 5.0% p10 net-goodput gain, >=98.0% recovery, no hash failure, and wins at least 7 of 8 order-balanced confirmatory pairs after signalling.
promotion_limits.screen_gate: At least 2.0% p10 net-goodput gain over P0 after signalling, predictor median held-out error <=15%, profile within 10% of measured oracle in >=80% of held-out cells, held-out Spearman >=0.5, and zero catastrophic optimistic selections.

purpose: minimum causal identifiability screen; not final 7/8 qualification

signalling.accounting: Both descriptor airtime and per-frame profile-ID payload displacement are included in candidate net goodput. P0 has no descriptor activation cost in the incumbent comparison.
signalling.bearer_assumption: uniform QPSK with the same rate-1/2 convolutional code across 935 bins
signalling.descriptor: two bits per eligible bin plus 128 metadata/CRC bits
signalling.profile_id_cost: 32 logical bits reserved from application payload in every data frame
